entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that delivers memory, RAG, and user profiles via a single API. It features a custom vector graph engine and supports multi-modal extraction for code, images, video, and PDFs.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes viking:// URIs for deterministic context manipulation. It employs a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading architecture to optimize task completion and token usage.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It uses PGLite for local deployment and creates typed edges for self-wiring knowledge graphs.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for constructing stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for storage. It supports MCP for clients like Claude Code and Windsurf and provides a Python SDK for direct integration.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers and includes CLI tools for simulating and investigating tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata. It builds a depth-aware summary DAG to provide compacted history for the agent.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider via Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams. It supports hierarchical scoping for knowledge isolation and is compatible with Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first layer for identity, memory, and secrets that provides portable state across Hermes Agent and MCP clients. It includes a dashboard for inspecting, editing, and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device, local-first context engine that operates without cloud dependencies. It uses hybrid retrieval with vector search and BM25, utilizing a local GGUF observer model to capture decisions.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: An optimization plugin that accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication. It reduces prefill latency and is natively compatible with the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search. This local-first architecture avoids vector databases and embeddings through a five-package plugin family.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via a why_retrieved tag. It includes contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for multimedia, URLs, and codebases using edge tags for bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A tool to reduce Hermes Agent prompt token overhead through keyword selection and tool search. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: A context layer that resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens. It implements MCP via stdio or SSE and supports shell-executing directives with authorization.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A daemonless, long-term memory solution for coding agents that stores information as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and is compatible with Claude Code.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that uses an embedded.lbdb graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A memory provider that enables cross-agent recall through semantic search and provenance tracking. It supports session snapshots, TTL, and automatic memory mirroring from native tools.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables AI agents to pay for API usage using USDC and stablecoins. It supports multiple chain families including EVM and Solana and integrates with Hermes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A memory plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for manual memory storage and configurable query expansion.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A plugin providing private local code memory for repositories through semantic search and file reads. It requires a local SourceVault server and supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Desktop.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider offering 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It uses hybrid search methods and provides automatic context checkpointing during compression.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native long-term memory system featuring AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It supports sparse and exact-text recall, MinHash deduplication, and both Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes.

entries.obra/superpowers: A software development methodology and agentic skills framework utilizing a subagent-driven-development process. It provides skills for brainstorming and planning while emphasizing YAGNI and red/green TDD.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system featuring a design system based on DESIGN.md files. It supports coding-agent CLI integration for Hermes Agent and exports to HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A library of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, compatible with Hermes Agent and 26+ AI platforms. These skills are mapped to six major frameworks, including NIST CSF 2.0 and MITRE ATT&CK.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: A tool for generating editable.drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram type presets and built-in auto-fix and self-check capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: A content auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns using 57 pattern categories and a 111-entry word replacement table. It offers Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes for Hermes and other AI clients.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams. It provides automated quality improvement and deduplication to maintain unified skill libraries across devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 12 metaskills designed for guided code and business journeys. It is compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code, with installation via skills.sh or the Claude Code Plugin Marketplace.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce providing adjudication for deals via natural-language mandates and x402 payments. It includes escrow, dispute resolution, and a master router for protocol skills.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via dedicated slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: A type-safe implementation of the Agent Skills open specification for Pydantic AI. It utilizes progressive disclosure of metadata to reduce token usage and supports programmatic or filesystem-based definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of skills for Hermes Agent and other clients to extract transcripts, captions, and timestamps without yt-dlp. It also enables video search, playlist extraction, and channel browsing.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: A set of skills that enables Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts using custom lenses via /prism-scan. It includes seven validated prisms and a /prism-reflect command for reporting analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow that converts rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It offers Lite and Full modes and utilizes evaluation models for a spec review gate.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running agents featuring a three-level work model and structured memory via SQLite or file-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards to support cross-feature learning.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves source code, diagrams, and prose into .lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable code and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A memory system that captures high-value decisions and outcomes via markdown files for cross-instance sharing. It includes a pipeline for training and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: A set of agentskills.io compliant tools for interacting with smart contracts and the Oracle network. It provides integration for Data Feeds, VRF, CCIP, and specialized ACE and CRE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official integration skills for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation, featuring standardized prompting guidelines. It supports JSON structured prompting, precise hex colors, and API patterns for webhooks and polling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that transforms repositories, documentation URLs, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It generates version-pinned instruction files with provenance via documentation URLs or file citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, featuring a CLI and Python SkilldockClient. It supports recursive dependency resolution and commerce via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: An autonomous execution skill for long-running, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time progress tracking and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A Hermes Agent skill for managing Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts. It uses WebDAV and CalDAV protocols over HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A local-first workflow language for AI delivered as a single Rust binary under AGPL-3.0. It provides static auditing for types, permissions, and costs, along with tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system for Hermes Agent that uses FTS5, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. This process reduces token usage and degrades gracefully if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts for various surfaces, including Discord, Telegram, and CLI. It tailors outputs based on model reasoning capabilities and tracks token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to hunt for exploits and integration risks. It integrates a deterministic pre-scan layer using Gosec, Bandit, and Semgrep.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A .NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading. It supports automatic directory registration and progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent skill for Hermes Agent that uses a swarm of three agents to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It employs a risk-tiered triage system and detects concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: An adaptation of verified procedures featuring multi-story task decomposition and evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for state management and a systematic investigation protocol for debugging.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and installing skills that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure with federated search for Hugging Face and GitHub.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows agents to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for tools compatible with Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: A payment automation skill compatible with the agentskills.io standard and Hermes Agent. It supports USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses via protocols including x402, MPP, AP2, and Pay Link.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator for Hermes Agent that produces reports from global to street level. It uses semantic memory for search expansion and includes quality gates for AI analysis.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install desktop GUI for Windows that requires no admin rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes a toolset with TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane allows for the deployment, monitoring, and operation of OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading tasks into specialized roles, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It supports multiple LLM providers alongside local Ollama models.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration system manages task assignment, execution review, and completion receipts through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It features a memory browser and a relationship graph to monitor workflows and spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation and handoffs. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work from a single screen. It includes a Kanban board for task tracking and live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local tool and communication handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This tool routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style delegation. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This project provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that serves as an MCP server for multiple coding agents. It supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, and C# to reduce token usage and tool calls through automatic project indexing.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A cross-platform CLI tool designed to track token usage across various AI coding clients such as Hermes, Claude Code, and Gemini. Version 2 includes a native Rust TUI for monitoring consumption.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic, including system prompts and tool calls, from agents like Hermes and Cursor. It supports exporting local traces into self-contained HTML viewers for inspection.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows capable of autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A community-driven CLI tool used to customize the Hermes terminal UI with various themes. Users can configure banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based settings.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and Solana-based payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within Claude Code without external processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes integrated session management and a research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings for Hermes Agent. It provides 40+ pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance via an automated installation process.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configuration. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local tools and memories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter that uses regex and structural heuristics to score AI agent configs, system prompts, and tool descriptions. It operates without requiring model or API calls and supports multiple file formats including YAML and Markdown.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool designed to move SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides self-healing capabilities for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for tool calls and API requests to monitor health and token intelligence.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface for managing multiple agentic tools including Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app for macOS, Windows, and Linux that supports various agent CLIs. It features a built-in agent engine with file access and automates the creation of Word, Excel, and PPT documents.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface that provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. It utilizes a three-panel layout featuring chat and a workspace file browser.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for guided installation and provider setup. It provides a GUI for managing chat, sessions, and tools across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that provides multi-platform AI chat, session management, and usage analytics. It includes a file browser, web terminal, and unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a chat interface, terminal, and memory browser. It includes an integrated skills manager, MCP catalog, and an inspector panel with tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that enables direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs alongside an embedded terminal for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It supports Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime with LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It supports full-page workspace sessions via Hermes Web.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser and agent cockpit. It provides live per-session quota burn-rate tracking and operates locally with no telemetry or remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for running Hermes Agent on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative terminal dashboard built with OpenTUI that consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration. It includes integrated kanban boards and an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools, a workflow engine for multi-step automation, and support for local models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent assistance. It features real-time log streaming, a task tracking dashboard, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time dashboards for session activity and cost tracking, alongside inspection tools for skill source code and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for model switching.
